name: The Shops at Montebello
description: The Shops at Montebello is an enclosed regional shopping mall serving the diverse communities of the San Gabriel Valley in eastern Los Angeles County. Featuring a mix of popular national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues, this center provides a convenient shopping destination for families and value-conscious shoppers throughout the region.
demographics: The Shops at Montebello attracts a diverse, predominantly Hispanic and Asian American customer base with middle-income households and multi-generational families. The trade area serves the greater San Gabriel Valley and eastern Los Angeles County, drawing visitors primarily aged 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $85,000. Shoppers frequent the center for a mix of value-oriented shopping and dining, with strong weekend traffic driven by family outings and local residents seeking convenient access to mainstream retailers and entertainment options.
summary: A regional shopping destination in Montebello offering mainstream retail, dining, and entertainment for the diverse San Gabriel Valley community.
